problem: On Saturday morning, the game club's cabinet held 38 tokens from different board games. After lunch, volunteers crawled under the tables, found more tokens and added them. The club leader wore a green apron. By evening the cabinet held 64 tokens. Work out how many tokens the volunteers found.

follow_ups.question: On Sunday they find 9 more tokens behind a shelf. How many tokens are in the cabinet now?
A complete collection has 80 tokens. How many tokens are still missing?

problem: Fourteen fishing boats were tied up in the harbor at dawn, and 8 more sailed in before noon. What was the number of boats in the harbor at noon?

follow_ups.question: During the afternoon, 6 more boats came back from the sea. How many boats were in the harbor then?
The harbor has space for 30 boats. How many more boats could still fit?

problem: Ravi collected some pine cones near the cabin on Friday. On Saturday his dad brought him 7 more, and then Ravi had 19 pine cones. On Friday, how many pine cones did Ravi collect?

follow_ups.question: That night he used 5 pine cones to light the stove. How many pine cones did he have left?

problem: The lighthouse keeper writes in her logbook every evening. On Tuesday she filled 6 pages, which brought her total to 23 filled pages. How many pages had she filled before Tuesday?

follow_ups.question: On Wednesday she fills 4 more pages. How many pages are filled after Wednesday?

problem: On the first morning of the jungle trip, Amara spotted 9 kinds of birds. By the end of the second day her list had 21 kinds. So how many new kinds of birds did she add on the second day?

The harbor bait shop opens at 6 in the morning. When Kenji unlocked the door, the fridge held 15 tubs of worms, and before breakfast a supplier dropped off 12 more. How many tubs were in the fridge after the drop-off?

follow_ups.question: In the evening, another 9 tubs are delivered and nothing has been sold. Find how many tubs the fridge holds now.

problem: When the family reached the mountain cabin on Sunday, the wood box had 11 logs in it. Grandpa, who is 72, chopped wood on Monday morning and filled the box up to 30 logs. How many logs did Grandpa add?

follow_ups.question: On Tuesday the family burns 8 logs. How many logs are left in the box?
On Wednesday Grandpa chops 13 more. How many logs are in the box after that?

problem: Seagulls were perched on the lighthouse railing at sunrise. An hour later, 9 more landed beside them, and Esi counted 17 birds. Before the extra birds came, how many seagulls were on the railing?

follow_ups.question: By noon, 5 more had landed. What was the number of seagulls on the railing at noon?

problem: On Tuesday morning the bee farm shop had 16 beeswax candles. After lunch, Farida brought in 13 more that she had made. Can you find how many candles the shop had then?

follow_ups.question: A customer buys 10 candles for a party. How many candles stay in the shop?
On Wednesday morning Farida brings in 7 more candles. How many candles does the shop have then?

problem: Our guide had some bananas in her pack when we set off into the jungle. At lunch a fruit seller gave her 8 more, so she had 20. How many bananas did she have when we set off?

follow_ups.question: The group eats 6 bananas in the afternoon. How many are left?
The next morning, at the river village, she is given 4 more. How many does she have now?
Each of the 9 hikers eats a banana at breakfast. How many bananas are left after breakfast?

problem: Some drummers were already marching when the parade passed the bakery. At the town hall, 6 more drummers joined, which made 15. How many were marching past the bakery?

follow_ups.question: After the town hall, 3 trumpet players joined too. How many musicians were marching then?

problem: Before Thursday's catch came in, a crate on the dock already held some crabs. The afternoon boat added 12 crabs, and the crate then held 31. How many crabs were in it before the boat came?

follow_ups.question: The cook takes 10 crabs for dinner. How many crabs stay in the crate?
On Friday the morning boat brings 15 more crabs. What is the number of crabs in the crate then?

problem: Bao had 25 coins in his game on Monday. If he won 14 more after school, what is his coin total now?

follow_ups.question: On Tuesday he spends 20 coins on a hat for his character. How many coins does he have left?

problem: Before dinner, Lucia had beaten 12 levels of her game. She played again after dinner. Her little brother watched from the sofa. Now she has beaten 20 levels. How many levels did she beat after dinner?

follow_ups.question: The game has 35 levels. How many levels does she still have to beat?
On Saturday she beats 6 of them. How many levels are still left?

problem: By Saturday night Hiroshi had fitted 48 pieces of his jigsaw puzzle. On Sunday he fitted 37 more. What is the number of pieces in place by Sunday night?

follow_ups.question: The puzzle has 96 pieces. How many pieces are still missing from the picture?
On Monday after school he fits 7 of them. How many pieces are still not in place?

problem: At the start of the desert trip there were 6 water bottles in the van. The family bought some more at the oasis stop and then had 18 bottles. How many bottles did they buy?

follow_ups.question: During the hot afternoon they drink 7 bottles. How many bottles are left?
That evening they fill 9 empty bottles at a well. How many full bottles do they have now?

problem: On Friday, 27 tents stood in the festival field. More tents went up on Saturday morning, and at noon there were 45. The first band plays at 3 in the afternoon. How many tents went up on Saturday morning?

problem: The mountain cabin has a guest book. It had 34 names in it before the Petrov family's visit and 41 names after it. By how many names did the book grow during their visit?

follow_ups.question: The next family adds 5 names on their first day. How many names are in the book then?

problem: On the jungle trip, the guide's camera already held some photos. During Wednesday's river ride she took 46 more, and that evening the camera showed 83 photos. Work out how many photos were on the camera before the river ride.

follow_ups.question: On Thursday she took 29 more photos at the waterfall. How many photos were on the camera then?

problem: By the end of March, Mr Okafor had finished 74 crosswords in his puzzle book. He finished 28 of them during March. Before March began, how many had he finished?

follow_ups.question: In April he finishes 19 more. How many crosswords has he finished by the end of April?

problem: Mei had 18 game cards left over in her box from an old set. On her birthday morning she was given 12 new ones. How many cards are in her box now?

The path has 25 lamps. How many are still dark?

problem: At the start of the week, Thandi's class puzzle chart showed 15 stars. The class solved riddles every day and earned more stars. Their teacher loves riddles. By Friday the chart showed 32 stars. How many stars did the class earn this week?

problem: Yesterday Joaquin's farm game had 64 chickens. Every night it adds new chicks, and last night it added 29. This morning, how many chickens does his farm have?

problem: Some bees were already resting on the hive's landing board when Esra came out at 8 in the morning. Soon 7 more bees landed there, and she counted 19 bees. How many bees were resting there at first?

problem: Wiremu won some tickets at the carnival on Friday night. When the stalls opened at 5 on Saturday, he went back and won 13 more. Then he had 30 tickets. How many tickets did he win on Friday?

problem: Snow fell on the mountain cabin all night. In the evening the snow on the porch was 8 centimetres deep, and by morning it was 23 centimetres deep. How deep was the new snow that fell overnight, in centimetres?
Ines started Saturday with 38 gems in her racing game. She raced all afternoon, and by bedtime she had 91 gems. Work out the number of gems she won that afternoon.
Kwame's tower game counts the floors he has built. This morning before school he built 27 more floors, and now his tower has 65. How many floors tall was the tower last night?

problem: Children were waiting in line for the carousel. After the 3 o'clock show ended, 9 more children joined the line, and now 24 are waiting. How many were in line before the show ended?
Sanjay's toy shop had 45 puzzles left on the shelf after Monday's sale. On Tuesday morning a delivery brought 38 more. How many puzzles were on the shelf after the delivery?

follow_ups.question: On Wednesday another 16 puzzles arrive. How many puzzles are on the shelf now?

problem: Mrs Lindqvist counts the sailboats in the harbor before breakfast: there are 21. During breakfast 7 more glide in. The water is calm and blue. Once breakfast is over, how many sailboats are in the harbor?

problem: Over the holidays, Yusuf's game library grew by 18 games, and it now holds 53. How big was his library before the holidays?

problem: The lighthouse museum had 46 visitors by noon on Sunday. When it closed in the evening, the count had reached 93. Find how many visitors came in the afternoon.
For the spring parade, the school float had 17 paper flowers on Monday. On Tuesday the children made 15 more. The float is shaped like a big boat. How many paper flowers does the float have now?

problem: The festival food stall had 26 pies remaining after Saturday. Early on Sunday morning the baker brought 19 more. How many pies did the stall have then?

follow_ups.question: By lunchtime on Sunday, it sold 30 pies. How many pies were not sold yet?

problem: Pedro's family plays a long board game every evening. On Tuesday the bank paid Pedro 35 coins, which gave him 82 coins. How many coins did Pedro have before the bank paid him?

follow_ups.question: On Wednesday he wins 16 more coins. How many coins does he have now?

problem: Before the parade started, 48 people had found seats on the grandstand. Over the next hour, 39 more people sat down. The mayor waved from the first car. Then how many people were sitting on the grandstand?

follow_ups.question: By the end of the parade, 25 more people had squeezed in. How many people were on the grandstand at the end?

problem: Ana's family plays dominoes every Sunday after lunch. Last Sunday Ana had 23 points at the break, and after the break she scored 16 more. What was her final score?

follow_ups.question: Her father finished with 8 more points than Ana. What was his score?

problem: The parade band carried 13 flags when it left the school at noon. Along the route, people handed the band more flags, and at the finish it carried 22. The route was 4 kilometres long. How many flags were handed to the band?

problem: Uma keeps brain-teaser cards in a box. She added the 11 cards she got on Saturday, and now the box has 28 cards. Each card takes about 5 minutes to solve. Before Saturday, how many cards were in the box?
Before game night began at 7, Viktor set out 24 game pieces on the table. His sister brought 18 more from her room. What is the number of pieces on the table now?

problem: On Friday afternoon the carnival staff hung 25 more teddy bears on the prize wall. That made 61 bears in all. How many bears were on the wall in the morning?

problem: Each evening this week, Zoltan's family put their board game winnings in a jar. The jar had 31 play coins on Wednesday night, and on Thursday night they put in 17 more. Find how many play coins are in the jar now.

problem: Some hammocks were hanging between the trees at the jungle camp before our group arrived. How many were there, if we hung 8 more and now there are 15?

follow_ups.question: The next day, another group hangs 6 more. How many hammocks are hanging now?

problem: The cookie tin at the cabin held 12 cookies on Friday evening. On Saturday morning Oskar's mum baked 24 more for the hike and put them in the tin. What was the total in the tin then?

follow_ups.question: On the hike, the family ate 15 cookies. How many cookies were left in the tin?
Back at the cabin, Grandma added 9 of her own cookies. How many cookies were in the tin now?

problem: Gita collected 7 smooth stones on Monday of the desert trip. She kept collecting all week. The sand there was orange. By Sunday she had 25 stones. How many stones did she collect after Monday?

follow_ups.question: She gave 4 stones to her friend. How many did she have then?

Before leaving, they buy 15 cans for the next guests. How many cans are in the pantry now?

problem: At sunrise, 9 camels were drinking at the oasis. Half an hour later 7 more camels walked up to the water. The oasis is 3 kilometres from camp. How many camels were drinking then?

Before noon, a trader brought 8 more camels. How many camels were at the oasis then?
In the afternoon, 12 camels lay down in the shade. How many camels were not lying down?

problem: Obi is painting the spiral staircase of a lighthouse that is 30 metres tall. He painted 19 steps on Monday and 14 more on Tuesday. By Tuesday evening, how many steps had he painted?

follow_ups.question: In the afternoon customers bought 9 jars. How many jars were left on the stand?

problem: The lighthouse gift shop got a delivery of 45 postcards on Tuesday morning. After the delivery it had 74 postcards. On Monday night, how many postcards did the shop have?

On Wednesday another delivery brings 36 postcards. How many does the shop have now?

problem: Finn is covered in mosquito bites from the jungle trip! Tuesday gave him 5 new ones, and now he has 13. How many bites did he have before Tuesday?

follow_ups.question: On Wednesday he wears bug spray but still gets 3 new bites. How many bites does he have then?

Before the next ride, 8 more kids joined the line. How many kids were in line then?

problem: Some lanterns hung over the festival square on Thursday. Workers hung 16 more on Friday morning, and by Friday evening 40 lanterns glowed over the square. How many lanterns were there on Thursday?

problem: By ten in the morning, sixty-five people lined Main Street to watch the parade. In the next half hour, 28 more people came. How big was the crowd then?

follow_ups.question: Just before the floats came by, 34 more people arrived. How many people were watching then?

problem: The harvest festival tent had 22 pumpkins on display on Friday. Farmers brought more on Saturday morning, and the tent then had 40 pumpkins. Find how many pumpkins the farmers brought.

follow_ups.question: On Tuesday 3 more suits came back from the cleaner. How many suits were in the shed then?

follow_ups.question: She tore out 9 drawings to give to the guides. How many drawings were left in her sketchbook?

follow_ups.question: Shoppers bought 40 fish by noon. How many were still in the tank?

problem: Some tourists boarded the desert bus at the hotel. At the market, 6 more got on, and then there were 20 tourists in total. At the hotel, how many tourists boarded?

follow_ups.question: On Monday the keeper gives 20 books to the school. How many books are left?

problem: Femi spent the morning at the carnival and won 15 tickets. He spent the afternoon there too and won 17 more. By evening, how many tickets did he have?

follow_ups.question: He traded 20 tickets for a yo-yo. How many tickets did he have left?
On Sunday he won 9 more tickets. How many tickets did he have then?

problem: Some people were waiting at the festival gate at sunrise. Over the next hour, 46 more arrived, and then 83 people were in line. The gate opened at 11. How many people were in line at sunrise?

follow_ups.question: Before the gate opened, 15 more people got in line. How many people were in line when it opened?

problem: The board game cafe had 19 games on its shelf on Monday. The owner bought new games on Tuesday. The cafe smells of hot chocolate. Now the shelf has 27 games. How many new games did the owner buy?

follow_ups.question: On Wednesday 2 games broke and were thrown away. How many games are on the shelf now?

problem: Before lunch, the desert camp's water tank held 25 litres. After the water truck came, it held 70 litres. How much water did the truck bring?

follow_ups.question: In the evening the campers used 18 litres. How many litres were left?

problem: A puzzle cube club met on Wednesday after school. At first 9 children came, and by the end of the meeting 16 children were there. How many children came late?

problem: At the carnival, a goldfish booth had some fish in its tanks before lunch. After lunch a worker poured in 35 more, and the tanks then had 72 fish. What was the number of fish in the tanks before lunch?

problem: Zanele is saving play money in a board game. At the start of her turn she had 45 dollars, and at the end she had 63 dollars. How much play money did she collect on that turn?

problem: Sione's game shows his total stars. On Friday night the total was 29 stars, and by Sunday night it was 76 stars. Over the weekend, how many stars did he earn?

problem: On Saturday, 43 bikes were parked outside the summer festival before noon. Fewer bikes came in the afternoon, only 29 more. What is the number of bikes parked there by evening?

problem: Kayak hire on the harbor beach starts at 6 in the morning, when 9 kayaks were lying on the sand. Paddlers coming back pulled more kayaks up, and by noon 17 lay there. What number of kayaks did the paddlers pull up?

problem: The beekeeper had already filled some frames with wax on Sunday. On Monday he filled 9 more, so now 21 frames are filled. On Sunday, how many frames had he filled?
